a11y.apg: Layout primitive, no role and no keyboard: it is a <div> that lays its children in a column. Semantics belong to what you put in it.

props.name: children
props.description: Vertical flow: a column with --space-4 between items. The gap has three steps and no others (ADR-0051) — a layout primitive that takes any spacing is how a system stops having spacing.

props.name: gap
props.description: Three steps and no others (ADR-0051): tight is --space-2, normal is --space-4, loose is --space-6. The old rule still holds against ANY spacing; these two extra steps exist for the two measured cases — a note under its value, and a grid of filters.

props.name: align
props.description: The cross axis. The default stretches children to the column width, as always; `start` keeps each child at its own width.

props.name: className
props.description: For alignment or width that this one job needs. Every other div attribute passes through.
